claims.claim: A strong neatly used kids bicycle
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a kids bicycle that appears intact, but it does not prove strength, safety, or how neatly it has been used (no close-ups of brakes/tires/chain/wheels).

risks.risk: Brake condition and stopping power (pads/shoes, cable tension) can’t be confirmed from this wide shot.
risks.proof: A short video of a test ride and hard braking from a few meters away, plus close-up photos of brake pads/shoes and cables.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a used kids bicycle with unknown brake condition (worst case: needs brake service).

risks.risk: Tire wear/sidewall cracks and whether the tires hold air.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires (tread + sidewalls) and a quick pump/hold-air test or video showing no deflation over time.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as needing tire check/replacement if worn or leaking.

risks.risk: Chain/sprocket wear and gear alignment (or single-speed condition) can’t be verified.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the chain and rear sprocket, and a video pedaling showing smooth chain movement without skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as unknown drivetrain condition (worst case: chain/sprocket service).

risks.risk: Wheel true/alignment and bearing condition (wobble, grinding) can’t be confirmed.
risks.proof: Spin both wheels in a video and show any wobble; close-up of hubs/bearings and axle area.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as possible wheel/bearing adjustment needed.

risks.risk: Correct size for the child (wheel size/frame size) affects value; not readable here.
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure or clear marking of wheel diameter (e.g., 12/14/16 inch) and frame size.
risks.if_unproven: Price it at the lowest likely kids-bike size bracket until size is confirmed.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of brakes (front and rear), including pads/shoes and cable condition.
Video of a test ride + hard braking (show the bike stopping safely).
Close-up photos of tires (tread and sidewalls) and a quick air-hold check.
Close-up photos of chain and rear sprocket + video pedaling (no skipping).
Wheel size confirmation (12/14/16 inch) with a tape measure or clear marking.
response.reason: The photo shows a kids bicycle that looks intact, but key safety/value factors (brakes, tires, drivetrain, wheel alignment, and exact size) are not verifiable remotely from this single wide shot.
